body: ac-00 (GATE, done — CONDITIONAL PASS): candle BERT path WORKS (candle-transformers 0.8.4 + tokenizers + safetensors, embeddable, DETERMINISTIC). But candle CPU gemm ~7x slower than torch/MKL: single-col 45.9ms (OVER 10ms budget 5x), batched(32) 10.6ms (essentially AT budget). Threading no help (66/46/49ms @ 1/4/8). Corpus low-band: single ~25h / batched ~5.8h vs 1.6h every-column baseline. NOT a NO-GO — viable path at/near budget via BATCHING; the discovery's 6.7ms torch number was optimistic ~7x. Build MUST batch the escalation + likely int8-quant (untested, next cheap lever) and/or smaller base. Interactive use fine regardless (sub-second/table). Code: crates/finetype-candle-spike/src/bin/minilm_latency.rs. Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/build_ac00_rust_latency.md. FOLLOW-UP before full build: int8 quant probe (ac-00.5).

ac-00.5 (done — Metal/GPU): the M1 GPU RESOLVES the latency objection. candle Metal vs CPU fp32: single-col 14.2ms (vs 45.8 CPU), batched(32) 0.07ms/col (vs 10.7 CPU, 150x), corpus low-band pass ~2min (vs 5.9h). Deterministic. CAVEAT: Metal is Apple-Silicon-only; FineType ships cross-platform. So GPU win applies to Mac-interactive + a Mac/CUDA-hosted corpus pass; no-GPU Linux/Windows hosts stay at CPU batched 10.7ms (at-budget, int8 the further lever). NET: latency no longer threatens the build (run batched always; corpus on GPU; interactive fine everywhere). Risk moves entirely to the accuracy/attractor question (ac-01/02). int8 quant probe now lower priority (GPU clears it). Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/build_ac00_5_metal.md.

ac-01/02 PREVIEW (bounded, NOT the production build — ac-01/02 stay open): MiniLM head on frozen encoder, values-only, trained on REAL distilled data (15885 rows), tested on the 244 gold/repr contested cols. THREE findings: (1) the residual ATTRACTOR does NOT reproduce — head UNDER-predicts residual (60/244 vs 129 truth) at 0.97 precision, doesn't collapse to the sink the multi-branch did; class-balancing slightly hurt. So the attractor is NOT the binding risk for this architecture (encouraging ac-03 update). (2) encoder separability re-confirmed: values-only 0.766, header+values 0.893, both > shipped 0.684. (3) BINDING RISK = TRAINING-DATA COVERAGE: head trained on CURRENT distilled hits only 0.648 on gold (BELOW shipped, far below 0.893 ceiling) — distilled residual class doesn't cover gold's contested cases (PA-is-plain-text, Si-is-status); residual recall 0.45, still over-emits specific. The encoder CAN separate (CV) but distilled doesn't TEACH the gold boundary. REFINES ac-01: needs headers (+13pp) + contested-residual training data, NOT just fine-tune-on-distilled. Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/build_ac01_ac02_preview.md + finetune_preview.py.

DATA LEVER PROVEN + GeoNames clean path (top-risk task): corpus-mined HEADER+VALUES training data lifts the gold contested set 0.648->0.82 (balanced), ~75% of the gap to the 0.893 ceiling, even with NOISY header-heuristic labels — proves headers (+13pp) AND contested-residual mining both convert. GeoNames vocab-membership labelling (author input, eval/gold/lens_reference/{cities15000,admin1,iso3166}) makes country_code/city/country NEAR-PERFECT (recall 1.0/1.0/0.91) but region COLLAPSES (0.07-0.33: admin1 name list under-covers real region values — needs iso_3166-2 subdivisions + state codes). CLEAN-VOCAB PATH reduces LLM spend: GeoNames (geo, generator scripts/generate_geonames_geography.py exists) + Wikidata (person/full_name, scripts/generate_wikidata_person_columns.py exists) build the bulk; distill_* LLM-labels only the ambiguous tail (entity_name + messy residual). Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/{contested_residual_mining_proof.md, mining_proof.py, geonames_proof.py}. ac-01 prerequisite RETIRED in principle.

DATA-ASSET INVENTORY (author asked to review all repo data): the repo already holds clean/authoritative sources covering essentially the ENTIRE contested-residual training need. KEY ADDS vs the overnight proof: (1) region gap CLOSED — ~/datasets/geonames/2026-05-24/admin2Codes.txt (47.5k counties) + eval/datasets/csv/us_states.csv cover the counties/districts gold 'region' mostly is (admin1-alone missed them); (2) iata gap CLOSED — eval/datasets/csv/airports.csv + ourairports/openflights snapshots; (3) residual-decoy negatives in hand — codes_and_ids.csv (isbn/uuid/swift/... = the 'looks like a code but isnt' shape); (4) person via people_directory.csv + Wikidata Q5 + generator; (5) city via world_cities.csv(33k)+cities500(38M). WEAK corroboration only (NOT clean labels): dbpedia_annotations.parquet (6.2M, 800/931 gold cov, but classes are property associations id/type/author — header-driven, noisy) + gated-YDF. Generators exist: generate_geonames_geography.py, generate_wikidata_person_columns.py, finetype generate. NET: ac-01 data is an ASSEMBLY+membership-labelling job over existing clean sources; LLM-labelling shrinks to the ambiguous tail (entity_name proper). Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/data_asset_inventory.md.

ENCODER ALTERNATIVES (author flagged HN 46081800 'stop using all-MiniLM-L6-v2'): switch the build's LEAD CANDIDATE from MiniLM-L6 to gte-tiny — a STRICT WIN. Head-to-head on the 244 contested (header+values, CV ranking, no-scaler): gte-tiny 0.872 > MiniLM 0.807 (+6.5pp) > bge-small 0.787 > static potion-32M 0.754 / potion-8M 0.750 > gte-small 0.717. gte-tiny = SAME 6-layer/384 BERT arch as MiniLM so IDENTICAL candle latency (CPU batched 10.6ms, Metal batched 0.09ms — confirmed by loading it into the existing minilm-latency bin, deterministic), HALF the disk (46MB vs 90MB), drop-in same candle path. Free accuracy upgrade, no speed/integration cost. The HN thread's big retrieval models (EmbeddingGemma 300M, Qwen3-0.6B, bge-base, nomic) are WRONG OBJECTIVE for us (bigger/slower, long-ctx retrieval, non-BERT candle-risk) — our task is short-input classification, CPU-latency-bound. Static caps ~0.75 (contextual still needed). Latency budget unchanged (same arch). Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/encoder_alternatives.md + alternatives_probe.py.

ENCODER SWEEP COMPLETE (author-flagged mdbr-leaf-ir + ModernBERT, both tested): both LOSE to gte-tiny. mdbr-leaf-ir (MongoDB, 23M, Apache-2.0, #1 BEIR<=100M, candle-runnable) separability 0.774 < gte-tiny 0.872 (IR pedigree doesn't transfer to classification). ModernBERT-embed-base (149M; candle HAS modernbert.rs so runnable) 0.778 AND ~5x slower CPU (39ms vs 7.4ms torch) — disqualified both axes, flash-attn/8k-ctx is GPU/long-ctx win irrelevant to short-input CPU. Full sweep (8 candidates: MiniLM, gte-tiny, gte-small, bge-small, potion-8M/32M, leaf-ir, ModernBERT): gte-tiny wins separability AND smallest/fastest. Repeated lesson: bigger general-retrieval/modern models DON'T separate our short-input type boundaries better; tiny+task-fit wins. gte-tiny remains lead. Caveat: zero-shot probe, fine-tune could shift but ModernBERT 5x CPU cost disqualifying regardless. Deliverable updated: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/encoder_alternatives.md (+ leaf_probe.py, modernbert_probe.py).

ac-01/02 FIRST CUT (frozen gte-tiny+head, family-level, 244-col — directional, ACs stay open): BEST contested acc yet = 0.836 (gte-tiny + REAL mined corpus columns + GeoNames-membership labels), beats MiniLM-same-recipe 0.82, shipped 0.684, ceiling 0.893. KEY FINDING: synthetic vocab-GENERATED columns score 0.635 (WORSE than shipped!) — distribution mismatch with gold's messy real columns; vocabularies' job is LABELLING mined real columns, NOT generating. ac-02 attractor: NO collapse (residual P 0.83-0.91 balanced). OPEN GAPS: (1) region recall 0.00-0.33 even w/ admin2+us_states — thin training (~600 cols pass membership) + messy gold values (County suffixes/uppercase/UK-NYC); needs targeted mining + format-robust matching. (2) end-to-end encoder fine-tune NaN'd on MPS (step 1, majority collapse) — known MPS instability, fix w/ grad-clip+warmup or CPU/CUDA; it's the lever to push 0.836->0.893 (current is frozen head). Recipe validated: mined-real + vocab-labels + gte-tiny. Next: fix region + end-to-end fine-tune + scale to 250-class + corpus-honest gate (the arbiter). Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/build_ac01_first_cut.md (+ build_encoder_train.py, finetune_gte_tiny.py, frozen_head_eval.py, ac01_corrected.py).

REGION FIXED + END-TO-END FINE-TUNE WORKS (both user asks delivered). REGION: recall 0.00->0.73 via format-robust matcher (case-fold + strip County/Parish/Borough suffixes from vocab AND values + NYC boroughs + ISO-3166-2 prefix strip; gold value coverage 24->65/90) + 9k mined real region/county columns (header-confirmed) -> ~3.5k clean region training examples. FINE-TUNE: after 2 failures (v1 full+class-weighted=NaN on MPS; v2 +gradclip+warmup full=catastrophic collapse/forgetting), v3 WORKS: freeze lower layers + train top-2 layers + head, discriminative LR (enc 2e-6/head 1e-3), NATURAL CE (no class weights), grad-clip 1.0, warmup. Result: 0.811 contested, region 0.73, country_code 0.96, city 0.88, full_name 1.0, RESIDUAL P0.88/R0.78 — BALANCED across all families (better real model than 0.836-frozen which abandoned region). loss 0.55->0.30->0.22 stable, ~65s/epoch M1. ac-02 attractor: no collapse (resid P0.88). LESSONS: don't full-fine-tune tiny encoder (forgets) — freeze lower+tiny LR; heavy class-weighting destabilises — natural CE + calibrate via gate not loss. RECIPE VALIDATED: mined-real + vocab-labels(format-robust region) + gte-tiny + gentle partial fine-tune = 0.811 no-attractor. Remaining: 250-class scale + corpus-honest gate (arbiter). Deliverable: output/fine-tuned-encoder-discovery/build_ac01_region_and_finetune.md (+ ac01_region_fix.py, finetune_v3.py).
